per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: No per-object cap is published for Storage Box. The WebDAV guide describes a 50 MB error only as a Windows client security setting that the user can remove, not as a server-side object limit.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No expiry or deletion period is published for stored files; the only retention term is the snapshot ladder 10/20/30/40 (BX11/BX21/BX31/BX41), where the oldest automatic snapshot is removed once the slot limit is reached and manual snapshots are kept until deleted.
